**Finding: compliant (preferred position met).**

The Agreement contains no liquidated damages, penalty, early-termination fee, or minimum-payment-on-termination obligation running against Juniper Ridge. Points checked:

- **§ 1.5 (Fees)** — service credits, interest and damages are carved *out* of Fees; no Customer-payable liquidated amount is created.
- **§ 7.3** — Vendor may not charge interest on amounts ultimately found not due (favourable to us).
- **§ 9.1–9.5 / § 10.1–10.2** — termination and post-termination effects impose no exit fee; § 10.2 gives us refunds of prepaid Fees.
- **§ 24.4** — Vendor cannot accelerate Fees on our change of control.
- **§ 27.3** — force-majeure termination is expressly "without penalty".
- **§ 22.2** — audit shortfall plus costs is a true-up, not a liquidated sum.

The § 2.1 take-or-pay commitment (USD 2,000,000/year, "without reduction or termination rights") is real exposure, but it is a minimum-volume obligation reviewed under the minimum-commitment rule; flagging it here would double-count the same commercial term.

No redline proposed.
